thread:
Ana (PM): Quick kickoff: we need a recruitment plan + go/no-go signals for the next beta cohort. Thinking: 16	6 partners, 6-week active window, 2 on Private sandbox. Agree?
Ravi (Research): Proposed channel mix: 45% power users, 25% integration partners, 20% product-fit startups, 10% community. Keeps diversity.
Priya (Eng): Engineering note: Private sandbox = non-trivial infra. Recommend strictly 2 private slots max. Each private sandbox ~2 engineer-weeks.
Sam (Solutions): If we promise Private, scope it as "sandbox evaluation" only. No production SLAs. Offer mock KMS and a VPC template.
Olivia (Growth): Outreach cadence: 3 touch emails + discovery call. Incentives: credits + prioritized roadmap input. I'll draft templates.
Jon (Design): Need onboarding UX that captures early signals. I suggest "beta signal matrix": setup time, API calls/day, week-3 CSAT, regression count.
Ana (PM): Can we convert that to a single numeric "commitment score" for week-4 gate? e.g., 0	60 pass threshold?
Ravi (Research): Yes. Proposed weights: setup time 20, API calls 30, CSAT 30, regressions 20. Threshold 60. Will pilot with 3 partners to calibrate.
Maya (CS): Add TTFS (time-to-first-success). If >72h, flag for concierge outreach.
Priya (Eng): We'll publish an SDK quickstart + prefilled cache/batching config to reduce TTFS.
Sam (Solutions): Screener draft (short form):
1) Use case (generation/embeddings/rerank): ______
2) Est. daily requests in beta: ______
3) Need Private sandbox? (yes/no) If yes, describe: ______
4) Security needs (SOC2/HIPAA/none): ______
5) Eng hours/week committed: ______
Olivia (Growth): For community recruits allow lower week-hour commitment but pair with research interviews. Enterprise must have PM+eng signoff.
Jon (Design): I'll make a one-page onboarding checklist + lightweight console checklist that pings CS when TTFS >72h.
DeployBot: Deployed: beta-playbook-draft, screener-form-v1. :white_check_mark:
Ana (PM): Next actions: finalize screener + signal matrix by Wed EOD, Olivia to draft outreach by Thu, Jon to ship onboarding 1-pager Thu, Priya to estimate Private sandbox effort Fri. Call out owners in thread.
Ravi (Research): I'll run a micro-pilot with 3 trusted partners to test the commitment score next week.
Maya (CS): I'll draft a concierge playbook for flagged partners (TTFS>72h or score<60). Recommend 2 proactive touches (week1, week3).
Sam (Solutions): Add an invite policy blurb: feature requests during beta are noted but not committed to timeline. Also clarify Beta support = best-effort; concierge for prioritized partners only.
Olivia (Growth): Sweetener idea: "30-min roadmap session with product leads" for select partners. Helps close enterprise participation.
Ana (PM): Nice. Also add a spreadsheet column "infra-impact" so Eng can capacity plan.
Priya (Eng): Include that tag. Also request a small "requires infra changes" flag on invites.
Olivia (Growth): Quick outreach snippets: "We're running a small, high-touch beta to shape our Dedicated offering 	6 early access + credits for active feedback. 20-30m to confirm fit?" and "We prioritize partners who can commit a 6-week feedback window and a technical contact."
Ravi (Research): Past lesson: ask for hours/week explicitly. Customers often overcommit verbally.
Maya (CS): Past lesson: concierge saved two pilot partners. Recommend allotting 4 concierge slots total.
Ana (PM): Great input. I'll merge into the beta playbook and schedule a recruitment kickoff Monday. Post any sample outreach lines or partner anecdotes here for Olivia.
